# acloud_cloud_accounts (Data Source)

List all cloud accounts within an organisation

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All cloud accounts of the organisation on AWS.
data "acloud_cloud_accounts" "aws" {
  cloud_provider = "aws"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud_account_name` (String) Cloud Account Name
- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud Provider Slug
- `organisation` (String) Organisation Slug

### Read-Only

- `cloud_accounts` (List of Object) Cloud Accounts matching the filters, each with `name`, `slug` and `available` (whether the cloud account can be used). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_accounts))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--cloud_accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_accounts`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `slug` (String)
